description_en: Mākaḥ Bāhāḥ, a branch of Si Bāhāḥ (LAL0690), is located to the right of the street from the main Bāhāḥ on the way to Chāya Bāhāḥ Bhindyaḥ (LAL0720). The Bāhāḥ can be reached by passing through an elongated four-storey building. This building has a line of eleven vertical windows on its first and second floors and seven central doors with another two doors on either side on its ground floor.The three-storey monument building is now plastered in cement and has been roofed with corrugated metal sheets. The principal façade of the building faces west and has a central carved door on its ground floor. This is flanked by two niches: the one to the left houses a statue of Gaṇeśa to the left whilst the right niche contains a statue of Mahākāla. These niches are well decorated with carved wooden frames,toraṇa thā̃and tympanums showing further images of the respective deities. The sunken sanctum floor is 45 cm below the level of the plinth but has a raised threshold. A five-layered carved timber cornice separates the ground and first floor. Above this cornice, further layers of cornice bricks (phyaḥ apāandmvaḥ apā) and three layers ofdāciapāover this reveal something of the original surface. A functional carved triple window (pasukājhyāḥ) is the centrepiece of the first floor, with two small blind windows on either side and a carved window above it. Two small lattice windows can also be found on the first floor near the edge of the building. The centralpasukājhyāḥseems to have been installed during the renovation of the building. The projecting balcony on the southern building has created a visual imbalance to the symmetry of the main façade.The sanctum of the Bāhāḥ is on the ground floor and there is notoraṇaon above its door. Instead, small images of Lokeśvara, Akṣobhya and Prajñāpāramitā have been carved on the wooden frames. A prominentśikharakūṭacaitya(205 cm high) is located at the centre of the courtyard. Statues of a donor, Vasundharā, and Bhīmasena are attached to the plinth of thecaitya. Tall buildings surround the courtyard.Devamuni Śākya ordered the construction of this Bāhāḥ in 1676 (Pruscha1975, P-71;Locke1985, 176). He was a member of the Mākaḥ lineage of the Śākyas clan, and it is from this that the Bāhāḥ got its name. Only one family takes care of the daily ritual worships. It seems that no other social religious activities take place here.
description_ne: यो सि बाहा: (LAL0690) को शाखा विहार हो । सि बाहा:का माक: खलकका शाक्यहरूले बनाएको बाहा: हुनाले यसलाई माक: बाहा: भनिएको हो । बाहा:को द्य:छेँ पश्चिमाभिमुख गरी तीन तलाको बनाइएको छ । द्य:छेँमा सिमेन्ट प्लाष्टर गरिएको छ । छानामा जस्तापाता राखिएको छ र छानाको बोझ थाम्न कुनै टुँडाल राखिएका छैनन् । द्य:छेँको दोस्रो तलामा तीनवटा साधारण झ्याल राखिएका छन् । पहिलो तलामा कलात्मक त्रिखाझ्याल राखिएको छ । यो तलामा बाहा:को आगम रहेको छ । भुइँतलामा बाहा:को गर्भगृह रहेको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पस्ने ढोकामाथि तोरण राखिएको छैन । तोरणको ठाउँमा बुद्ध, धर्म, संघको प्रतीक स्वरूप बीचमा अक्षोभ्य राखी दायाँ-बायाँ प्रज्ञापारमिता र लोकेश्वर राखिएका छन् । गर्भगृहभित्र ढुंगाको अक्षोभ्यलाई क्वा:पा:द्य:को रूपमा स्थापना गरिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पस्ने ढोकाको उत्तरमा गवाक्ष बनाएर गणेश र हनुमानको मूर्ति राखिएको छ भने दक्षिणमा महाकाल स्थापना गरिएको छ । यो बाहा:मा गर्भगृहमा जाने सिँढीको दायाँ-बायाँ सिंह राखिएका छैनन् । बाहा: प्राङ्गनमा दाताको मूर्ति, शिखरकूट चैत्य, वसुन्धरा र भीमसेन स्थापना गरिएका छन् ।यो नेसं ७९६ (सन् १६७६) मा देवमुनि शाक्यद्वारा स्थापना गरिएको थियो (Pruscha1975, P-71;Locke1985, 176)। यो बाहा:को सञ्चालन एउटा मात्र परिवारले गरिरहेको छ । यहाँ बिहान नित्यपूजा गर्ने बाहेक अन्य कुनै धार्मिक गतिविधि हुँदैन ।

historical_events.event_description: Devamuni Śākya, asaṅghamember of Si Bāhāḥ ordered the construction of this Bāhāḥ. He was from the Mākaḥ lineage of the Śākya clan.
